Name: Benhail, Prince of Judah
Summary: Benhail was one of the princes Jehoshaphat sent in his third year to teach in the cities of Judah.
KeyStory: In Jehoshaphat's third year he sent his princes, including Benhail, to teach in the cities of Judah.
LifeLesson: God's law taught throughout the land, and willing service under a faithful king, strengthened Judah.
